title: Corset Fitting Physics Simulator
description: A rigged humanoid figure stands on a platform while the user adjusts a corset's lacing tension, vertical position, and rotation to achieve a target fit. The simulation enforces conservation of total fabric stress energy across all lacing points, meaning tightening one region redistributes tension elsewhere. Users must balance multiple coupled parameters and can undo/redo adjustments to reach the goal configuration.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads both Corset.glb and RiggedFigure.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the RiggedFigure upright at the origin and position the Corset centered on the figure's torso area. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 1.2, 3) looking at (0, 1, 0). Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (2, 3, 2) with intensity 1.2, plus a subtle hemisphere light. Add OrbitControls for camera navigation. Implement a UI panel (HTML/CSS overlay) with these interactive controls: (1) A vertical slider to move the corset up/down along the figure's torso (Y-axis, range 0.6-1.4). (2) A rotation knob (range -30 to +30 degrees) to twist the corset around the Y-axis for alignment. (3) Four horizontal tension sliders (Front, Back, Left, Right) each ranging 0-100, representing lacing tightness. Enforce a conservation law: total tension across all four sliders must always equal 200. When one slider changes, proportionally redistribute the deficit or surplus among the other three. Visually reflect tension by scaling the corset mesh along corresponding local axes (higher tension = slight inward squeeze on that side using non-uniform scaling between 0.85 and 1.15). (4) A 'Fit Score' display (0-100%) computed from how close the current position, rotation, and tension distribution match a randomly generated target configuration shown as ghost outlines (semi-transparent green). (5) Undo and Redo buttons that maintain a history stack of all parameter changes (position, rotation, tensions). Each state change pushes to the stack. Support at least 20 history levels. (6) A 'Randomize Target' button to generate a new goal. (7) A 'Reset' button restoring defaults. Animate the corset with a subtle breathing oscillation (sinusoidal Y-scale pulse ±2% at 0.8Hz). Display the current parameter values numerically beside each control. When Fit Score reaches 95%+, flash a green success banner. Ensure smooth 60fps rendering with requestAnimationFrame.
